text:
sophia: Quick sync — we need pricing + guardrails for the new 'Priority Lane' add-on (Dedicated customers). Customer asks: 3x throughput SLA, burst credits, and per-route soft limits. Need guidance on hard limits, overage handling, and negotiation points. TL;DR: how to price and what to ship for pilot?

jin: From infra POV: 3x sustained throughput is doable if they reserve capacity + autoscale. Propose hard cap = 5k qps per tenant, soft burst up to 10k qps for 10 minutes. After burst window, route to fallback model (standard lane) and emit throttle events. Example config:```json
{"max_qps":5000,"burst_qps":10000,"burst_window_secs":600}```. Also need telemetry for burst_used and throttle_count.

oliver: Product suggestion: two-tier add-on. Priority-L1 = 2x throughput, lower fee. Priority-L2 = 3x + burst pool, premium. Burst credits monthly refresh, non-transferable, no rollover. Keep start simple for GA.

marco: Sales heads-up: customers will ask for "unlimited burst". Must have clear contract language: defined burst pool, overage rate (e.g., $0.10 per 1k tokens or equivalent compute unit), and an escape hatch for both parties. Also require minimum term / commit for Priority-L2.

emily-sales: For SMB pilot we can offer 50k burst credits as an incentive. Sales needs a short playbook with negotiating levers (commit size, trial bursts, limited timeframe). I'll prepare a one-pager. :rocket:

legal-bot: Flag: "unlimited burst" contract requests must be rejected. Any custom SLA that changes core uptime/availability needs legal review. Recommend standard clause: "Burst credits are not guaranteed beyond defined pool; provider may throttle to preserve platform stability."

sophia: Proposed launch criteria: docs + sample pricing sheet, SDK flag and console quota UI, billing meter + alerting, and 2 pilot customers signed. Target GA in ~6 weeks if pilots go well.

jin: I'll add autoscale policy code path and telemetry events: priority_lane.qps, priority_lane.burst_used, priority_lane.throttle_count, priority_lane.fallback_count. Need log retention for 30d for investigations.

oliver: Action items: update pricing spreadsheet, draft contract clause, create pilot list. @emily-sales @marco can you lock 3 pilot customers by EOD Friday?

emily-sales: On it — pinging Acme and Nova now, also looping in BetaCo. Will update the pilot tracker. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: NOTE: feature-flag "priority-lane" toggled ON in staging for integration testing.

sophia: Sync notes in pitch doc: <https://redwood.internal/docs/pitch/priority-lane> (draft). If anyone objects to the two-tier model or the burst constraints raise now; otherwise we'll lock pricing next week and start legal reviews.

marco: No objections from sales. Will surface any customer asks that require contract exceptions.

jin: Quick technical caveat — if multiple tenants burst simultaneously we need cross-tenant burst policing at the cluster level. I'll add a rate-limiter fallback and an emergency throttle policy.

sophia: Thanks all. I'll circulate final PRD + pricing proposal tomorrow. Short sync on Friday if needed.
